correctness.rationale: PASS: The D4 root model consists of 24 roots ±e_i±e_j, with adjacency when dot product 1 (96 edges). Deleting opposing cutting facets yields terminal L/H and middle I blocks; the eight-seam-root subgraphs are isometric 3-cubes, so shortest cross-cell paths may be monotone. For A={a:r·a=1}, sigma(a)=r−a and phi(a,b)=0 if a=b, 2 if b=sigma(a), 1 otherwise, the independently inspectable 8x8 base distances give d_I(−a,b)=1+phi(a,sigma(b)). phi satisfies the triangle inequality and is sigma-invariant, so min-plus T^p=p+phi(a,sigma^p(b)) for p>=1. Exhaustive small-root endpoint table has maximum terminal correction 4 attained by exactly nine ordered L/H pairs, versus eight for other block combinations; consequently m−1 seam traversals yield diameter m+2 and only nine terminal-to-terminal diametral pairs for every m>=2. Direct reconstruction of quotient facet graph for m=2..6 gave 14m+10 vertices and exactly nine diameter pairs; m=2 histogram (164,374,156,9). The finite 8-root kernel/endpoint table is exhaustively checkable and the min-plus induction supplies unbounded m; finite m tests alone are not the infinite proof.
